stills.description: MIAMI (March 16, 2018) — With stability issues addressed NTSB Investigator in Charge Robert Accetta examines the debris from the collapsed bridge on the FIU campus. The NTSB’s Go Team began arriving on scene at 10 p.m. Thursday and has been working around the clock to gather information and evidence in its investigation of the accident. (NTSB Photo by Chris O’Neil)
